# Drop Custom Blender GLB Models Here

Place your exported `hdd.glb` file in this directory:
`public/models/hdd.glb`

Refer to `BLENDER_EXPORT_GUIDE.md` in the root folder for the exact sub-mesh naming conventions (`top_cover`, `platters`, `actuator_arm`, `rw_heads`, etc.).
When `hdd.glb` is present, the app will automatically load and animate it instead of the procedural CAD assembly!
